## Summary

Worked in `/opt/nxeon` on board card `cmst1v0tr` ("Fix email dashboard on admin portal"). The admin webmail page is `app/admin/inbox/page.tsx` (not `app/admin/mail/page.tsx`, which is the separate "Deliverability" analytics tab). ### Issue 1 — runs off the bottom of the screen (root cause + fix)
`/admin/inbox` is registered as full-bleed in `components/portal/Shell.tsx`, so its content renders inside `<main className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden">`. The admin layout (`app/admin/layout.tsx`) also stacks the `AdminSubTabs` bar (the Inbox / Deliverability / Mailboxes / Email templates tabs visible at the top of the screenshot) as a **sibling above** the page inside that same `<main>`. The page wrapped `MailClient` in `<div className="h-full">`, which resolves to 100% of `<main>` and ignores the tab bar's height — so the client (message list, reading pane, and the Compose/storage footer) got pushed the height of that bar past the viewport bottom and clipped by `overflow-hidden`.

Fix: sized the wrapper to `h-[calc(100vh-8.5rem)]` (viewport minus the 4rem sticky header minus the ~4.3rem sub-tab bar). `MailClient` is `h-full` internally and scrolls its own panes, so the whole surface now fits inside the admin content area. This matches the pattern the other full-bleed admin page uses (`BoardClient` → `h-[calc(100vh-4.5rem)]`; it's single-tab so it has no sub-tab bar to subtract).

### Issue 2 — "admin can't read the default mailbox" (diagnosis + hardening)
I could not reproduce a resolution failure — the admin-side mailbox resolution actually works. I verified end-to-end against live data:
- All 4 `CompanyMailbox` rows (`admin@`, `contact@`, `santino@`, `support@` `nxeon.cloud`) have valid AES-GCM `passwordEnc` that decrypts, and each logs into IMAP successfully with real messages (e.g. `admin@` = 25 msgs/17 unseen).
- `resolveMailbox` (`lib/mail/imap.ts`) has a correct staff-only branch: for a staff `user.role` (from `requireUser()`/`currentUser()`, which carries `role`), it `findUnique`s the `CompanyMailbox` by the passed address and synthesizes a `ResolvedMailbox`. The admin page always passes an explicit company address, so this branch is always taken and works.

So the resolution/IMAP layer is sound; the practical "can't read it" was the overflow clipping the UI off-screen (Issue 1). The card's premise that it "works on the customer/dashboard side" isn't literally true — staff have no customer `Mailbox` rows, so `/dashboard/mail` shows "no mailbox" for them; company mail is only reachable via `/admin/inbox`.

I did find and fix a real fragility matching the symptom: the page hard-selected `mailboxes[0]` (alphabetically `admin@`) and, if that one mailbox failed to load, the **entire** inbox dead-ended on the error card — the admin couldn't even switch to a working company mailbox because `MailClient` never mounted. I changed the server load to try the requested/default mailbox first and then **fall back through the remaining company mailboxes in order**, landing on the first that loads (switcher still lists them all). The error card now only appears if none are reachable. This keeps the admin able to read company mail even when the default is temporarily down. I deliberately did **not** modify shared `lib/mail/imap.ts` (customer webmail territory, and no defect there).
